title: 038 - Query Builder
prompt: Fix the bug so the program build the query string exactly as ?page=2&sort=new and prints exactly `?page=2&sort=new`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function queryBuilder(string $text, string $query): bool
{
    return str_contains($text, strtolower($query));
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function queryBuilder(string $text, string $query): bool
{
    return str_contains(strtolower($text), strtolower($query));
}
hint: The string needs the correct separator between the key-value pairs.
explanation: The broken builder uses the wrong separator. Using ? for the first pair and & between later pairs fixes the URL.
